activity.summary: Checked the new RSS feed generator for edge cases on empty post lists.
Resolved a drag-to-reorder glitch that dropped items on fast swipes.
Added coverage for the weather API's rate-limit retry logic.
Split the batch-rename utility into smaller, testable functions.
Corrected a rounding error in the monthly spending chart totals.
Documented the new typing-indicator prop and usage examples.
Added unit tests for ingredient-matching against partial pantry lists.
Flagged a potential memory leak in the streak-calendar re-render.
Fixed a collision case where two short codes could be generated identically.
Rewrote the setup guide for the static site generator's config file.
Consolidated duplicate format-conversion logic into a shared helper.
Added integration tests for offline sync after reconnecting.
Patched a race condition in message history loading on slow networks.
Suggested extracting the category color logic into a shared constant.
Added usage examples for the new batch-conversion flag.
Covered streak-reset behavior when a day is skipped.
Fixed incorrect ingredient substitution suggestions for dairy-free searches.
Simplified the click-analytics aggregation query.
Added a quickstart section for the weather API wrapper.
Added tests for corrupted-file handling during batch resize.
